prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce one polished, high-fidelity original desktop web application UI screenshot, landscape roughly 1536x1024, flat front view, no physical device, no perspective, no photography. This is a proposed redesign of the user's own Chinese stock-information service TheMarketBrew. Core workflow: add holdings -> agent filters material news -> read a short, sourced personal brief. Brand emerald green. Chinese Simplified UI text must be crisp and legible, sensible product design, plausible implementation in HTML. No emojis, AI sparkles, glassmorphism, neon, 3D decoration, invented ratings, buy/sell controls, profit dashboard, or gratuitous charts. Demo tickers and events are fictional illustrative data; display a visible header label "设计概念 · 示意数据" and footer "示意数据，非实时行情". Primary navigation only "今日简报", "我的持仓", "历史"; account settings a small secondary control. User-facing copy must describe investment information, not technical implementation. Source tags are text labels, not fabricated web URLs. Each screen contains only 2-3 important events, concise evidence and why it matters to holdings; sources and timestamps; compact coverage status. All three concepts are alternatives, not three modules to build simultaneously.
Design direction A: "持仓简报 / THE DAILY LETTER". A distinctive calm editorial service: warm ivory #F7F5EF background, offwhite surfaces, warm ink #242821, deep emerald #176B52 action, thin grey-green rules #DDDCD4. Very generous breathing room, left-aligned serif Chinese page title (Songti-like) and modern sans-serif body. Serif wordmark TheMarketBrew at upper left, quiet top navigation, right small initials circle. 1120px content container, 760px main letter plus 240px margin notes. Top eyebrow "你的持仓，今天只需看这 2 件事". Very large elegant heading "少看一点，知道重点。" Subheading "已检查 8 只持仓 · 更新于示例日盘后". Main story list is two numbered open editorial blocks separated by thin rules, not floating cards: 01 "英伟达更新收入指引" ticker NVDA, small subdued amber "值得留意". Body "这与你关注的 AI 需求有关。下一步看订单能否转成收入。" sources "公司公告 · 2 条来源", text link "查看依据 →". Story 02 "利率变化，影响你的科技股估值" chips MSFT AMD, one line body "对组合的影响来自同一个因素，合并为一条。" right margin note titled "我的持仓" NVDA 25% MSFT 20% AMD 10% "+ 5 只"; tiny "+ 添加持仓". Below "接下来" two compact calendar lines "财报更新" and "通胀数据". Bottom quiet divider and line "其余 6 只持仓：本次覆盖内未发现重要新增" and outline button "查看全部持仓". Main content 70%, white space 25%, accent <5%. Headline 40px, article title 23px, body 16-18px. Do not add a chart. Top image caption integrated subtly "A / 持仓简报". Make this feel like a carefully typeset personal financial letter, not a generic SaaS dashboard.

Design direction B: "重要信息收件箱 / SIGNAL INBOX". Bright white #FAFBFA, near-black #18231E, restrained emerald #147D5A selected states, thin #E5E9E6 separators. Crisp efficient email/inbox product with visibly distinct 3-column structure: narrow 176px left nav, 360px middle priority list, wide 650px right reading pane. Upper left wordmark TheMarketBrew, bottom user profile. Left nav "今日简报" selected, "我的持仓", "历史"; section labels "筛选" and "全部 / 值得留意 / 已读". Top content heading "今天，有 2 件事值得看。" with status "已检查 8 只持仓 · 示例日盘后". Middle list header "未读 2", first selected row NVDA with green left selection line, headline "收入指引发生变化", snippet "关系到你关注的 AI 需求", source "公司公告 · 盘后". Second row MSFT / AMD headline "同一项利率变化，影响两只持仓". Third muted row "其余持仓暂无重要新增" no invented news. Right reading pane is beautifully typeset long enough but concise: pill "NVDA · 我的持仓", large title "收入指引发生变化", one sentence abstract, thin divider. Three clearly spaced sections "发生了什么", "为什么与你有关", "接下来关注什么", each 1-2 short lines, no unnecessary cards. A subtle pale emerald quote zone "你记录的持有理由：持续观察 AI 基础设施需求。" Source block "查看原始依据" with "公司公告" and "财报资料". Bottom actions horizontal "已读" primary, "有帮助" outline, "不相关" text. Small optional follow-up link "追问这条信息". No infinite empty chat input, no mailbox unread pressure, no large total count. Top integrated caption "B / 信息收件箱". Clean premium productivity design, generous text spacing, polished realistic icons only if essential.

Design direction C: "持仓观察台 / PORTFOLIO WATCH". Warm near-black #121611 background, charcoal-olive panels #1B211C, offwhite #EEF2E9 text, muted sage #ABB5A9, emerald #7AC5A6, small amber #E2B96B. Flat refined financial instrument, no glow or gradients. Top wordmark TheMarketBrew and ONLY 3 nav links. Main heading "你的持仓，有哪些变化。" small text "8 只持仓 · 本次检查完成 · 示例日盘后". Main area a 55/45 split: left wide portfolio information table, right one event evidence panel. Table title "我的持仓" and compact "+ 添加". Columns "持仓", "权重", "信息变化", "最近检查"; rows NVDA 25% "指引更新" amber text, MSFT 20% "利率影响" amber, AMD 10% "利率影响" amber, AAPL 15% "暂无重要新增" muted, SPY 30% "暂无重要新增" muted. Use elegant monospace only for tickers and numbers. Selected NVDA row soft green surface with 2px left accent. Right panel heading "NVDA" then large "收入指引发生变化". A concise relation diagram made of plain text stacked with thin connectors: "公司指引 → AI 需求判断 → 你的持有理由". Below section "需要核实" with 2 short text lines, "原始依据" source tags, and action "查看详情". Bottom full-width narrow section "接下来的一周" with only three calendar events separated by hairline vertical dividers, dates "周二", "周三", "周五" and labels "财报更新", "通胀数据", "持仓复查". A quiet status line "未覆盖的信息会单独提示". This is an evidence monitor, not a trading terminal; no stock price charts, no P&L, no market heatmap, no candlesticks, no trading buttons. Body text >16px. Top integrated caption "C / 持仓观察台".
